caption: A ceiling fan running at full speed is switched off at the wall, and the blades keep turning for a while before coming to a stop.

sa.check: A ceiling fan is running at full speed.
It is switched off at the wall.
The blades keep turning after the switch.
The switch is thrown first, then the blades run on, then they stop.

pc.expect: After the switch the blades slow steadily, keeping the direction they were already turning, until they stop.
pc.fail: The blades speed up after the switch; or they reverse direction as they slow; or they slow and then pick up again.

pc.expect: The blades come to rest only by slowing down, and they stay at rest once stopped.
pc.fail: The blades halt in the same frame the switch is thrown; or they stop dead while still turning quickly; or they start turning again after coming to rest.

pc.expect: The blades stay flat and rigid and turn together about the hub.
pc.fail: A blade bends or droops as it slows; or the blades turn at different speeds from one another; or a blade flexes like cloth.

pc.expect: The fan hangs from its mount on the ceiling and stays there while the blades slow.
pc.fail: The fan drifts down away from the ceiling; or it tilts and stays tilted with nothing holding it; or it rises up into the ceiling.

pc.expect: The fan keeps its number of blades and its shape throughout.
pc.fail: A blade vanishes or an extra one appears; or a blade passes through the ceiling or through the hub; or the fan turns into another fixture.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The blades' colour, the fixture and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: The blades change colour; or the light fitting under the fan changes shape; or the room behind rearranges between frames.
